sensorDraft.scope.en: Settings preview only. Nothing is recorded, counted, uploaded or published, and no permissions are requested.
sensorDraft.scope.zh-Hans: 仅预览设置。不会录音、计步、上传或发布，也不会申请权限。

sensorDraft.choose.en: Choose a type; no defaults are filled in
sensorDraft.choose.zh-Hans: 请选择类型；不会自动填写默认值

sensorDraft.invalidField.en: Enter a whole number within the stated range. Blank values remain missing.
sensorDraft.invalidField.zh-Hans: 请输入所示范围内的整数。空白值会保持缺失状态。

sensorDraft.preserved.en: This saved setting isn't supported and can't be edited. It's kept as is.
sensorDraft.preserved.zh-Hans: 此已保存的设置暂不支持，无法编辑，已原样保留。

sensorDraft.unavailable.en: This draft is no longer available in the current session.
sensorDraft.unavailable.zh-Hans: 当前会话无法继续查看此草稿。

sensorDraft.valid.en: Configuration values are valid. Device behavior has not been tested.
sensorDraft.valid.zh-Hans: 配置数值有效，尚未验证设备运行效果。

sensorDraft.invalid.en: Current input is incomplete or invalid. You can still save it locally.
sensorDraft.invalid.zh-Hans: 当前输入不完整或无效，仍可保存为本地草稿。
